How to start Shizuku without a computer:
1. Install Shizuku from Google Play.
2. Settings → About phone → tap “OS version” 7 times to unlock Developer options.
3. Settings → Additional settings → Developer options: turn on “USB debugging” and “Wireless debugging” (Wi‑Fi must be on).
4. Open Shizuku → “Pairing”. Then in Wireless debugging choose “Pair device with pairing code” and type the code into the Shizuku notification.
5. Back in Shizuku, tap “Start”. After a reboot you need to tap Start again.
Xiaomi/HyperOS: also turn on “USB debugging (Security settings)” in Developer options. Without it the phone blocks changing settings and permissions.
The scan only reads information. Nothing on the phone is changed.
